Pragya is an incoming PhD student in the Intelligent Earth CDT program at the University of Oxford. 
She finished her Master's in Artificial Intelligence at Imperial College London and, prior to that, worked as a quantitative researcher at Goldman Sachs.
Her research interests include geometric and topological machine learning, especially their applications to natural sciences.
